Shrimp and Clam Dip
By: Sheri Wetherell
Published: Monday, December 21, 2009 - 11:12pm

Ingredients




2 (8 oz.) pkg. of softened cream cheese
1 flat can minced clams  (drain and save juice)
1 flat can shrimp (drain and save juice
Hot sauce

Preparation

1 Mix all together using juice from clams and shrimp for dip consistency. Hot sauce to taste.
